title: Feed Later Bridge
user: RSS readers who mark articles for later but do not want a separate proprietary read-later silo or a manual copy/paste routine.
smallest_useful_product: A local-first web/extension pair that imports a user-designated RSS/Atom saved-items feed, deduplicates entries, lets the user mark/annotate a compact queue, and exports OPML/Markdown/JSON.
constraints: Fetch feeds only from user-provided URLs; protect against feed HTML/script injection and SSRF in any companion service; retain only local reading metadata by default.
